name: Medical Education App (MAI)
description:
## About MAI

Medical Education App (MAI) is an AI-powered learning and clinical decision support platform built for resident doctors. It combines realistic case simulations, structured diagnostic workflows, and personalized learning tools into one integrated experience.

### Core Modules

Clinical decision support (two-stage differential diagnosis), patient case management and documentation, medical imaging workflows with AI annotations, pharmacology safety checks and dosing tools, clinical rounds summaries and document generation, and personalized learning with quizzes, flashcards, and mind maps.

### Architecture

MAI follows a clean, feature-first architecture with a shared core layer and mock data generation service. State management uses the Provider pattern, and routing is handled with Go Router.

### Mock Data System

The MVP uses a robust mock data service to simulate ICD-10 diagnoses, patient demographics, lab results, and learning progress for realistic workflows.

features.title: Clinical Decision Support
features.description: Two-stage differential diagnosis workflow with history taking, physical exam, tests, and management planning.

features.title: Case Management
features.description: Patient dashboard with filtering, new case workflow, privacy settings, and tabbed case views.

features.title: Medical Imaging
features.description: DICOM upload simulation, AI scan analysis, annotated viewer, comparisons, and report generation.

features.title: Pharmacology & Drug Safety
features.description: Treatment plans, interaction alerts, dosing calculator, and alternative medication suggestions.

features.title: Clinical Rounds
features.description: Rounds dashboard, voice recording simulation, AI transcript review, and automated summaries.

features.title: Personalized Learning
features.description: Learning hub with mind maps, flashcards, quizzes, audio summaries, videos, and guideline scenarios.

features.title: Analytics & Progress
features.description: Performance dashboard, mastery heatmaps, and case completion tracking.

faq.question: Is this connected to real patient data?
faq.answer: No. This MVP uses mock data only. It is designed as a proof-of-concept for educational workflows.

faq.question: Does it support multiple platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. The app targets iOS, Android, Web, and Desktop using Flutter's multi-platform capabilities.

faq.question: Can this be integrated with a backend?
faq.answer: Planned for future phases. The roadmap includes REST APIs, authentication, and cloud persistence.
